name: Local Corporation
summary: Local Corporation operates as a technology and advertising firm, specializing in delivering relevant localized search results to online users across the United States who are seeking businesses, products, and services. Its comprehensive suite of local search advertising solutions includes Local.com, a prominent digital platform accessible via its website and mobile application, which consistently attracts around 20 million distinct visitors each month. The company also manages a hosted network, a vast repository of local business and product information paired with ad feeds. This network is integrated into approximately 1,000 partner websites, collectively drawing roughly 5 million unique users monthly. Further expanding its advertising capabilities, Local Corporation provides a syndication network for ad distribution, along with dedicated display and pre-roll video networks designed to significantly boost brand visibility and reach for advertisers through the dissemination of customized visual and video content. Within its search results, the firm integrates various advertising models, including pay-per-click, pay-per-call, and standard display ad units. To enhance the user experience, it additionally furnishes detailed information such as photographs, customer ratings and reviews, video content, special offers, and operational hours. This supplementary data is accessible across its proprietary digital platforms, its network affiliates, and other third-party partners. Established in 1999, the organization was initially known as Local.com Corporation before officially adopting its current name, Local Corporation, in September 2012. Its principal operations are headquartered in Irvine, California.
